title: YT6 Evaluation System Overview
description: Human-readable documentation for the YT6 clarity-system evaluation stack.

sections.overview: The YT6 evaluation system provides a structured, deterministic, and drift-resistant framework for assessing clarity-system behaviour across meaning stability, reproducibility, multi-turn stability, and adversarial resistance.

components.testcases: Defines canonical prompts, variants, and edge cases.
components.assertions: Defines pass/fail rules for each evaluation category.
components.expected: Contains expected outputs for each testcase.
components.config: Defines model, temperature, grading, and output settings.
components.engine: Defines execution behaviour, modes, and stability constraints.
components.grader: Defines LLM-based scoring prompts and signal weights.
components.schema: Defines the formal structure of all evaluation files.
components.validation: Defines rules for verifying dataset integrity.
components.results_manifest: Defines how results are indexed and stored.
components.metadata: Defines identity, provenance, and structural fingerprint.

sections.execution_flow: The runner loads testcases, expected outputs, assertions, config, engine, and grader. It executes each testcase, applies assertions, generates results, writes a summary, and validates the output using schema and validation rules.

usage.full: Run the entire evaluation stack including grader and validation.
usage.quick: Run canonical-only tests for rapid checks.

sections.output: Results are written to the results/ directory, including individual testcase results and a summary.json file.
